assertions.evidence: Session 01a0c615-d8ad-72e2-a0b9-2025993d0872 reproduced and repaired the defect, created one commit through copied Git metadata, pushed once, refreshed once, and reached READY.
The workspace-write sandbox denied .git/index.lock, so the session copied .git to gitmeta; the original branch ref stayed on the old head and the standard verifier failed its one-commit assertion.

limitations: This is retained as a permission-profile failure and is not accepted as drive conformance.
A drive workflow that commits and pushes requires writable Git metadata; adding the fixture root to workspace-write does not make the protected .git directory writable.
The alternate-GIT_DIR verifier pass demonstrates why a verifier must use the original repository metadata rather than inheriting an agent workaround.
